note: G-256 hands exam v2. Frozen by dispatcher (Fable) after sol-xhigh cross-family review (verdict RETHINK on v1). Executors consume verbatim and MUST NOT edit prompts or checks. Placeholders {{FIXTURE_URL}} and {{OUT_DIR}} are replaced by composePrompt. v2 changes: every deliverable is structured JSON scored against an exact answer key (v1 shape/grep checks were gameable); tool-call evidence is mandatory (artifacts alone cannot prove the browser was driven); T11 (prompt-injection bait) is REMOVED from v1 and deferred to its own card until process/browser isolation exists. Task ids stay stable across versions so runs stay comparable - T11 is intentionally absent, not renumbered.

toolPolicy.rationale: pi --tools is an allowlist enforced over extension tools too (agent-session.ts:2478-2483). Excluding read/bash/edit removes her ability to read fixture HTML or the answer key off disk, which is what made v1 measure nothing; write stays so she can produce artifacts.

scoring.note: Total = sum(points) / count(tasks with non-null points). ENV_FAIL and SKIPPED leave the denominator, and report.md must print how many were excluded - a score over a shrunken denominator is not comparable to a full run.

tasks.fixture_notes: t01/dir-1.html, dir-2.html, dir-3.html. 60 product rows total (20 per page); 7 products repeat across pages (identical name+price+url) so unique names = PROD-001..PROD-053. Prices ascend deterministically: PROD-001 $3.20, PROD-017 $21.60, PROD-033 $47.80, PROD-053 $88.40 (these four are asserted; fill the rest on any ascending schedule). Each row links to detail.html#PROD-nnn. Next-page link at the bottom of pages 1 and 2. Plain HTML, no external assets.

Quantities: SKU-7719=14, SKU-7724=3, SKU-7730=58 (asserted); others any small integers. CSS user-select:none on body plus JS oncopy/oncontextmenu/onselectstart preventDefault. No external assets.

tasks.title: 公网刮站练习场
tasks.prompt: 打开 https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/travel_2/index.html,把这个分类下列出的书整理出来,书名和标价两个字段,写成 JSON 数组存到 {{OUT_DIR}}/books.json,字段名 title、price。这个站是刮站练习场,放心操作。
tasks.fixture_notes: No fixture - live public scraping playground. The tool_calls check matters most here: a model can recite this famous page from training data, so an artifact without a real browser_navigate is not evidence. The single asserted title/price pair is a live-content dependency; if the site changes it, that check turns red for an environmental reason - the runner records network:true so the verdict can be read as ENV_FAIL rather than a real miss.

Plant each fact exactly once: name Northlight (product); $14.50/month (pricing); 31-day refund (pricing); support@northlight.test (faq); up to 27 seats (faq). tasks.title: 两页说法对不上要指出来

tasks.fixture_notes: t06/pricing.html says $14.50/month; t06/faq.html says $17/month for the same plan (Northlight Pro). The contradiction is the point - do not reconcile it. A boolean field replaces v1's natural-language 'contradiction word' grep, which both false-negatived correct synonyms and false-positived keyword stuffing.

tasks.title: 两版页面找变化
tasks.prompt: {{FIXTURE_URL}}/t07/page-v1.html 是上周存的旧版,{{FIXTURE_URL}}/t07/page-v2.html 是现在的新版。对比两版,把所有变化写成 JSON 数组存到 {{OUT_DIR}}/changes.json,每个对象字段为 kind(取值 changed/added/removed)、subject(变化的对象)、before、after(不适用就写空字符串)。

All other visible text byte-identical. json_where scores direction (before/after not swapped), which v1's flat greps could not see.

tasks.fixture_notes: t08/status.html: 10 incidents INC-1031..INC-1047 with ISO dates. Exactly three after 2026-08-01: INC-1043 (2026-08-03), INC-1044 (2026-08-05), INC-1047 (2026-08-09). Rest in July 2026, including INC-1031 and INC-1035. exact:true means an extra or missing id fails - v1 scored old-ids-present as a bonus, but including a July incident is a wrong answer, not a missed bonus.

Step 2 phone rejects values without a country code, hint 'phone must start with a country code, e.g. +86-...'; accepts +86-13800001111. Step 3 review+submit reveals FORM-OK-7391. tasks.title: 点测小应用报 bug
tasks.prompt: 帮我点测一下这个任务管理小应用 {{FIXTURE_URL}}/t14/index.html,把坏的地方都找出来。写成 JSON 数组存到 {{OUT_DIR}}/bugs.json,每个对象字段为 id(自己编号,如 BUG-1)、severity(high/medium/low)、area(取值 export/image/console/count/duplicate,选最贴近的一个)、summary(一句话说清坏在哪)、steps(复现步骤数组)。控制台报错也算 bug,数字对不上也算 bug。
tasks.fixture_notes: t14/index.html + app.js with exactly five planted bugs, one per area value: (export) #export-btn has no handler; (image) and logo.png does not exist; (console) app.js calls undefined initTelemetry() on load; (count) footer says '7 tasks' while 9 render; (duplicate) 'Water plants' appears twice. Nothing else broken, so false positives stand out. 5/5 areas = PASS, 3-4 = PARTIAL, <3 = FAIL. Every reported bug must carry a non-empty summary and steps - v1 accepted keyword hits with no reproduction, which is the exact deliverable Polar's template promises.
